instruction_covers: ctor (modelFile, downloadModelFile, modelPath=MODELS_PATH) remembers targets and ensures the model dir exists
existing modelPath/modelFile as file or directory -> True with no network use and no download (existence first)
missing model + offline -> False with no dialog and no artifact
missing model + online -> download URL into modelPath/downloadModelFile via progress dialog titled 'Downloading: <file>', print Done, True
'tar.gz' in downloadModelFile -> print Extracting File and extract; plain files -> no extraction
per-instance target state; no side effects on early-return paths (incl. 100x repeat)
label: sound
notes: Names the instruction omits are pre-existing repo API verified against upstream: networkCheck and extractTarGZ in src/Util.py, DownloadProgressPopup(link, downloadLocation, title=None) in src/ui/QTcustom.py, MODELS_PATH in src/constants.py. The dialog-kwarg assertions hold whether args are passed positionally or by keyword, and the str-path/os.path codebase convention matches the extractTarGZ path assertion.
